scope: Local native runner/engine regression checkpoint; final scenario replay, final-head CI and release remain pending

before.failureInjection: nonempty directory blocks atomic CDB replacement

invariants: Retiring process retains its previous CDB until stop returns
Only the latest pending plan is published before the successor starts
Ordinary incremental publication does not force an engine restart
Generated prime/stub inputs exist when their CDB publication is recorded
Failed CDB writes neither record success nor start a successor with the wrong CDB
Failed first and replacement plans remain retryable; later desired plans replace them
Configuration undo drains explicit finite work before counting, including all fast builds from the moment of undo
Missing/incomplete/restarting state cannot pass the finite-work drain
notes: The old implementation comparison was run with the new retirement/failure tests; the later generated-input ordering regression is an additional case in the after count.
An initial empty-directory failure injection was replaced because the filesystem atomic writer legitimately removes an empty destination directory. Its unsuccessful trial remains in ignored logs.
The finite-work helper is also used by U13 without changing idle resource gates.
